basic_info.description: Ideally located in the highly regarded neighborhood of Jordan Park on Commonwealth, one of its most distinguished blocks. 44 Commonwealth offers a 4-bed, 4-bath of refined living space on an extra-wide flat lot. This rare offering blends timeless character with modern comfort in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods.  A gracious foyer with a classic staircase and wall trim sets the tone, leading to a formal living and dining room ideal for everyday living or entertaining. The highly enviable family/kitchen living area has been opened up and features an updated chef's kitchen with informal dining, flowing into a bright family room, opening to the expansive walkout garden. Just off the family room is a private office, ideal for work or study.  The lush walk-out backyard with an impressive grassy lawn, offering abundant space ideal for alfresco dining, play, and outdoor activities rarely seen in The City. The second level home features a spacious primary suite and 3 gracious additional bedrooms with 2 baths. Up to the 3rd level is a fun loft space that can be used in many ways.  Lower level two-car garage and storage rooms. This exceptional property combines timeless character with modern comfort and outdoor living, all in one of SF's most sought-after neighborhoods.
